description: I smell gas in the kitchen near the stove
Outlet in the bedroom sparked and now there's a burning smell
Toilet overflowing and won't stop even after I turned the handle
Sewage coming up through the bathtub drain
Heat is out and it's 25 degrees outside
Front door lock is broken, door won't lock
AC stopped working, it's 95 degrees today
Slow drip under the kitchen sink, I put a bowl under it
No hot water since this morning
Scuff marks and a small hole in the hallway drywall

note: Ambiguous on purpose: low battery vs. alarm. Team should decide the expected label.
